title: How Do Screen Protectors Actually Work? - BGR
summary: Most smartphones use a capacitive touch screen that's coated with a conductive material. However, even when using a high-quality protector that's installed properly, you may notice a slight lag in touch-screen performance if your protector uses multiple layers to provide impact protection.
